first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation, while prior evidence links it to faster time-to-value and early adoption. Promotional pricing is the main alternative given competitive pressure, but its effect on long-term customer quality, retention, and post-discount revenue should be verified before preferring it for a sustainable qualified-revenue objective.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure: its qualified-revenue lift was accompanied by 30-day retention -12% and failure through first renewal.
